title: Oversight Quality Metric Suite: Beyond Accuracy to Multi-Dimensional Oversight Evaluation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Richer metrics reveal safety-relevant properties hidden by accuracy alone. Directly addresses the safetywashing concern that single metrics are insufficient. Clear chain to better oversight evaluation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Defining and implementing multiple metrics (accuracy, calibration, consistency, bias direction, recovery rate) requires statistical knowledge. Each metric has its own implementation challenges. Moderate to high complexity for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five different metrics, each requiring separate implementation and validation. Plus empirical testing on actual oversight data. This is a substantial software and analysis project. Hard to complete in 30 hours.
